chunks: And [We sent] Lot, when he said to his people: "Do you commit the lewd act which none in the worlds preceded you with?"
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Lot say to his people about their unique sin?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-A'raf, Prophet Lot (peace be upon him) confronts his people about their unprecedented sexual deviance, specifically sodomy, which he notes had no precedent among the worlds. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a distinct moral failing that set Sodom apart, serving as a precursor to the broader divine punishment described in subsequent verses. The emphasis on 'unprecedented' underscores the severity of their innovation in sin, marking it as a unique corruption of natural human conduct.
